boundary: This is a decimal unit-system witness layer, not a dimensionless prediction layer.  G and proton mass use rounded CODATA mantissas; g0 and atm are conventional exact values; Faraday and R are exact SI-derived constants but the promoted integers are rounded display mantissas.
claim: Six non-SI-defining or derived constants have substrate-clean unit-scaled decimal witnesses when their exact/conventional/measured status is kept explicit.

sources.CODATA: NIST CODATA 2022 values; G=6.67430(15)e-11, proton mass energy equivalent=938.27208943(29) MeV, Faraday=96485.33212..., R=8.314462618...
sources.SI: NIST SI 2019 for exact defining constants; standard gravity and standard atmosphere are conventional exact standards.

witnesses.name: Newtonian constant G
witnesses.status: measured value; substrate claim is for the CODATA displayed mantissa

witnesses.name: standard gravity g0
witnesses.status: exact conventional standard, not a measured constant

witnesses.name: standard atmosphere
witnesses.status: exact conventional standard, not a measured constant

witnesses.exponent_witness: keV scientific exponent 5 = F5; MeV scale -3 = -q
witnesses.name: proton mass energy equivalent
witnesses.status: measured value; substrate claim is for nearest-keV rounded mantissa

witnesses.name: Faraday constant
witnesses.status: exact SI-derived value; substrate claim is for displayed rounded mantissa

witnesses.name: molar gas constant
witnesses.status: exact SI-derived value; substrate claim is for 1e6-rounded mantissa
